selected_result: Ordering property of the R factor under QR factorization with column pivoting

bibliographic_source.title: Accuracy and Stability of Numerical Algorithms, 2nd ed., Chapter 19: QR Factorization, Problem 19.5

paper_locations.anchor: Problem 19.5: the inequalities satisfied by R from column pivoting, and their relation to (10.13)

task_clarification: Let A have QR factorization with column pivoting as defined by the source at (19.15), producing the factor R.
Formalize r_kk^2 >= sum_{i=k}^{j} r_ij^2 for j = k+1:n and k = 1:n.
These are the same inequalities as (10.13) for the Cholesky factorization with complete pivoting.
scope_constraints: Column pivoting is the strategy defined by the source at (19.15).
This is an exact algebraic property of the computed factor, not a rounding-error bound.
State the index ranges exactly as given.
Represent the pivoted factorization rather than assuming the inequality.
